macros.name: aepurposehead
macros.doc: The command \aepurposehead prints the heading for the application element test purposes subclause.

macros.name: aetpbp
macros.doc: Prints the boilerplate for the introduction to the Application element test purposes clause.

macros.name: aimenthead
macros.doc: Command to start an AIM entity clause.

macros.name: aimpurposehead
macros.doc: The command \aimpurposehead prints the heading for the AIM test purposes subclause.

macros.name: aimtpbp
macros.doc: A command to print the introductory boilerplate for an AIM test purpose clause.

macros.name: apasserthead
macros.doc: Command to start an ‘Application assertions’ clause.

macros.name: apobjhead
macros.doc: Command to start an application object clause.

macros.name: atcbp
macros.doc: The command \atcbp prints the first paragraph of the boilerplate for the clause.

macros.name: atcbpii
macros.doc: The command \atcbpii prints paragraphs 3 and onwards of the boilerplate.

macros.name: atchead
macros.doc: The command \atchead prints the heading for the abstract test cases clause.

macros.name: atcposttpc
macros.doc: \atcposttpc prints boilerplate for the Postprocessor Test Purposes Covered subclause.

macros.name: atcpretpc
macros.doc: \atcpretpc prints the boilerplate for the Preprocessor Test Purposes Covered subclause.

macros.name: atsimtpbp
macros.doc: The command \atsimtpbp prints boilerplate for the clause.

macros.name: atsintroendbp
macros.doc: The command \atsintroendbp produces the boilerplate for the end of the Introduction to an ATS.

macros.name: atsnoclassesbp
macros.doc: The command \atsnoclassesbp prints the entire boilerplate for the Conformance class annex when the AP has no conformance classes.

macros.name: atspurposebp
macros.doc: The command \atspurposebp prints boilerplate for the introduction to the clause.

macros.name: atsscopebp
macros.doc: The command \atsscopebp produces boilerplate for an ATS Scope clause.

macros.name: atsusagehead
macros.doc: Command to start an ‘ATS Usage scenarios’ annex.

macros.name: confclassannexhead
macros.doc: The command \confclassannexhead prints the heading for the conformance classes annex heading.

macros.name: confclassbp
macros.doc: The command \confclassbp{<number >} prints the boilerplate for the introduction to a conformance class subclause, where <number > is the number of the conformance class.

macros.name: confclasshead
macros.doc: The command \confclasshead{<number >} prints the heading for a conformance class <number > subclause.

macros.name: domainpurposehead
macros.doc: Command to start a ‘Domain test purposes’ clause.

macros.name: extrefpurposehead
macros.doc: Command to start a ‘External reference test purposes’ clause.

macros.name: generalpurposehead
macros.doc: The command \generalpurposehead prints the heading for the general test purposes subclause.

macros.name: gtpbp
macros.doc: Command to print the boilerplate introduction to General test purposes clause.

macros.name: gtpvchead
macros.doc: The command \gtpvchead prints the heading for the general test purposes and verdict criteria clause.

macros.name: gvatcbp
macros.doc: Command to print the boilerplate introduction to General verdict criteria clause.

macros.name: gvcatchead
macros.doc: The command \gvcatchead prints the heading for the general verdict criteria for all cases subclause.

macros.name: gvcpostbp
macros.doc: Command to print the boilerplate introduction to General verdict criteria for postprocessor clause.

macros.name: gvcposthead
macros.doc: The command \gvcposthead prints the heading for the general verdict criteria for postprocessor cases subclause.

macros.name: gvcprebp
macros.doc: Command to print the boilerplate introduction to General verdict criteria for preprocessor clause.

macros.name: gvcprehead
macros.doc: The command \gvcprehead prints the heading for the general verdict criteria for preprocessor cases subclause.

macros.name: implementpurposehead
macros.doc: The command \implementpurposehead prints the heading for the implementation method test purposes subclause.

macros.name: otherpurposehead
macros.doc: Command to start an ‘Other test purposes’ clause.

macros.name: pisfbp
macros.doc: The command \pisfbp{<12 or 21 >}{<url >}{<ref >} prints the boilerplate for the annex.

macros.name: posthead
macros.doc: The command \posthead prints the title for the postrocessor subsubclause.

macros.name: postipfilehead
macros.doc: The command \postipfilehead prints the heading for the postprocessor input file names annex.

macros.name: prehead
macros.doc: The command \prehead prints the title for the preprocessor subsubclause.
